profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building web and mobile applications using Node.js, Vue.js, AWS, Dart, and Flutter. I currently develop serverless, cloud-native solutions with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, and CloudWatch, while also building responsive frontend experiences with Vue.js and Tailwind CSS. My background spans backend services, frontend development, mobile apps, and cloud infrastructure, with experience across industries including tourism and e-commerce. I enjoy solving real business problems through scalable architecture, clean code, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Fort Lauderdale, Florida, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
As a Full Stack Software Engineer, I architect, develop, and maintain scalable web services using JavaScript technologies across both frontend and backend. My role focuses on building serverless, cloud-native solutions with AWS and delivering responsive, intuitive user experiences with Vue.js. I work closely with product, design, and DevOps teams to implement robust, secure, and maintainable features.

Key responsibilities:
Develop RESTful and event-driven backend services using Node.js and AWS Lambda in a serverless architecture.
Design and maintain frontend interfaces using Vue.js, Vuex, and Tailwind CSS, ensuring a responsive and user-friendly experience.
Build and manage DynamoDB tables, implement efficient data access patterns, and optimize query performance.
Set up and manage API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch, and IAM to support scalable and secure AWS-based solutions.
Write and maintain infrastructure as code using tools like AWS SAM or CloudFormation.
Collaborate on CI/CD pipeline development and deploy serverless applications using GitHub Actions and CodePipeline.
Monitor system health, handle incident response, and continuously improve observability using CloudWatch Logs and metrics.
Participate in sprint planning, code reviews, and agile ceremonies to ensure high development velocity and code quality.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Architect, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications using Node.js and Vue.js in a cloud-native AWS environment.
• Build serverless backend services with AWS Lambda and API Gateway, including RESTful and event-driven integrations.
• Design and optimize DynamoDB data models and access patterns for scalable, high-performance workloads.
• Implement and maintain frontend features with Vue.js, Vuex, and Tailwind CSS to deliver responsive, user-friendly interfaces.
• Configure and support AWS services including S3, CloudWatch, and IAM to improve security, observability, and operational reliability.
• Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and deployment workflows using CloudFormation/AWS SAM and CI/CD pipelines.
• Partner with product, design, and DevOps teams in sprint planning, code reviews, and feature delivery.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.locationName: Miami Shores, Florida, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Developed, tested, debugged, and maintained software applications for client projects.
Built applications using Flutter, Firebase, SQLite, Java, Spring Framework, Docker, Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL.
Applied clean architecture principles and modern Flutter patterns, including state management, routing, JSON serialization, internationalization, and local persistence.
